question: Can a judge's or a member of the Ministério Público's legal position, taken in interpreting the law, be the 'interesse ou sentimento pessoal' that art. 319 requires? ADPF 881 is pending (vista, 29.4.2025); the 2022 liminar excluded it, and the relator later withdrew that position. Entry M-sweep-c-02.

readings.description: Interpretive legal positions are categorically outside art. 319; liability remains only for dolo or fraud beyond the ethical and legal limits of the function, causing harm or undue advantage (Toffoli's 2022 liminar, never referendado).

citations.cite: STF, ADPF 881 MC (Min. Dias Toffoli, 2022), as reported by Conjur 17.10.2023

readings.description: Art. 319 applies to these agents on its terms; what excludes ordinary interpretation is the specific intent the type requires, which must be proved, not a categorical exclusion (Fachin and Gilmar Mendes, 2023; Toffoli's revised vote and Zanin, 2025).

citations.cite: STF, ADPF 881, virtual plenary 2025, relator's revised vote, as reported by Migalhas 29.4.2025

question: Does desacato reach every disrespect of a public official in or because of the function, or only serious and evident contempt for the public function (ADPF 496 ementa, item 5)? Entry M-sweep-c-05.

readings.description: Any act of 'desacatar' an official in or because of the function, as the text reads.
Only serious and evident cases of contempt for the public function; officials must tolerate criticism and disapproval.

citations.cite: STF, ADPF 496/DF, Tribunal Pleno, j. 22.6.2020, ementa item 5 (DOU 23.11.2022, via the Senado norma page)

question: Does the constitutional privilege of self-defence exclude art. 307 when the agent gives a false identity to the police to hide a record? Entries M-sweep-c-06 (STF) and M-sweep-c-07 (STJ).

readings.description: Self-defence covers giving a false identity to avoid self-incrimination; not typical.
Typical despite alleged self-defence; formal crime, consummated on giving the false data.

question: Whose acts can be the 'determinação do poder público' whose infringement art. 268 punishes? Entry M-sweep-c-08.

readings.description: Only federal acts, since penal law is the Union's exclusive competence (CF art. 22, I).
Infralegal acts of the União, Estados, DF or Municípios, each within its sphere.

question: How are art. 359-L and art. 359-M combined when both are charged for one course of events (8 January 2023), and does the art. 359-M-B reduction apply? The STF held concurso material with no consunção (AP 2668; 295 convictions). Since 8.5.2026 art. 359-M-A imposes concurso formal próprio for Capítulo II crimes in one context and art. 359-M-B reduces the penalty in a crowd context, but their application has been suspended in the STF's 8 January executions since 9.5.2026 and five ADIs are pending. Entries M-sweep-c-09 and M-sweep-c-26.

readings.description: One absorbs the other (359-M as the graver, or 359-L as the means).

citations.cite: STF, AP 2668/DF, 1ª Turma, 11.9.2025, rejects it (via LexML)

readings.description: Autonomous types with desígnios autônomos: penalties summed under art. 69, no 359-M-B reduction. The STF's holding; governs where 359-M-A and 359-M-B are not applied — while the 9.5.2026 suspension lasts, the STF's 8 January executions.

citations.cite: STF, decisions of 9.5.2026 in the execuções penais, as quoted by Agência Brasil

readings.description: Art. 359-M-A: for Capítulo II crimes in one context, the graver penalty (359-M, reclusão 4 a 12 anos) increased by one-sixth to one-half under art. 70 first part, never above the art. 69 sum (art. 70, parágrafo único), even with desígnios autônomos; plus 359-M-B's 1/3-2/3 reduction in a crowd context for agents who neither financed nor led; reaching earlier facts as lex mitior (CP art. 2º, parágrafo único).
Arts. 359-M-A and 359-M-B struck (formal and material grounds argued in the ADIs), leaving concursoMaterial everywhere.

citations.cite: STF, ADIs 7966, 7967, 7968, 7969, 7985 (pending), per Congresso em Foco 14.7.2026

question: For facts before 8.3.2026 (before § 4º-A), can the presumption that a victim under 14 is vulnerable be relativised (e.g. a relationship or prior experience)? From 8.3.2026 § 4º-A forbids it. Entries M-sweep-c-10 and M-sweep-c-11.

readings.description: Absolute: consent, prior experience and relationship are irrelevant.
Relative for facts before § 4º-A, open to distinguishing in exceptional cases.

citations.cite: CF art. 5º, XL; CP art. 2º (non-retroactivity of the harsher § 4º-A)

question: May a slight or superficial libidinous act with a person under 14, done to satisfy lust, be reclassified as importunação sexual (art. 215-A)? Entry M-sweep-c-12.

readings.description: Yes, where the act is slight or superficial.

citations.cite: STJ repetitive thesis of 1.7.2022 rejects it (via TJMG)

readings.description: No: with the lust purpose present it is always art. 217-A.

citations.cite: STJ repetitive thesis, acórdão published 1.7.2022 (via TJMG)

question: In crimes against sexual dignity, may the aggravating circumstance of art. 61, II, f and the increase of art. 226, II both apply? Entry M-sweep-c-13.

readings.description: Never both: that would punish one circumstance twice.
Both apply, except where the only link is the agent's authority over the victim, when only art. 226, II applies.

question: Which ação penal governs crimes of Título VI Caps. I-II committed before 25.9.2018 (Lei 13.718/2018)? Entry M-sweep-c-14.

readings.description: The current text (always unconditioned) applies to earlier facts too.

The 2009 wording governs earlier facts: representation required, save the cases that wording excepted; estupro with real violence proceeds unconditioned (STF Súmula 608); temporary vulnerability with recovered discernment needs representation (STJ Súmula 670).

question: Does the princípio da insignificância ever apply to crimes against the public administration? Entries M-sweep-c-15 (Súmula 599), M-sweep-c-16 (descaminho) and M-sweep-c-17 (cigarette contraband).

readings.description: Never, as Súmula 599 reads on its face.

citations.cite: STJ's own repetitive theses carve out arts. 334 and 334-A (via TJMG)

readings.description: Not in general (Súmula 599), but for descaminho up to R$ 20.000 absent repeated conduct (Tema 157 and the reiteração thesis) and for cigarette contraband up to 1,000 packs absent repeated conduct (Tema 1143).

citations.cite: STJ Temas repetitivos 157 and 1143, and the reiteração thesis of 5.3.2024 (via TJMG)

question: Does moeda falsa reach a counterfeit so gross it cannot deceive? Entry M-sweep-c-19.

readings.description: Yes: any falsification of currency.
No: art. 289 needs a falsification capable of deceiving; using a gross counterfeit is in principle estelionato (art. 171).

question: Is a falsity exhausted in the estelionato or descaminho it served, with no further harmful potential, punished as well? Entry M-sweep-c-20.

readings.description: Yes, in concurso with the crime it served.

citations.cite: STJ Súmula 17 and Tema 933 reject it

readings.description: No: it is absorbed by the crime-fim, even when the crime-fim carries the lower penalty.

question: Is frustração do caráter competitivo de licitação (art. 337-F) a formal crime, needing no proof of loss or advantage? Entry M-sweep-c-21.

readings.description: Formal: consummated by frustrating or defrauding competition with the stated intent.
Requires proof of loss or of the advantage obtained.

citations.cite: CP art. 337-F (carry-over of Súmula 645 not verified)

question: Is disobeying a police order to stop a vehicle, given in ostensive policing, the crime of art. 330? Entry M-sweep-c-22.

readings.description: Not the crime of art. 330.
Typical under art. 330.

question: Is sonegação de contribuição previdenciária (art. 337-A) typified only after the definitive constitution of the credit, as SV 24 requires for Lei 8.137/1990 art. 1º, I-IV? Entry M-sweep-c-23.

readings.description: Yes: prosecution depends on the end of the administrative procedure and the definitive constitution of the credit.

citations.cite: MPF 2ª CCR Enunciado nº 79, as reproduced by Dizer o Direito (not a court; no STF or STJ holding on art. 337-A was read)

readings.description: No: SV 24's text is confined to Lei 8.137/1990 art. 1º, I-IV.

citations.cite: STF Súmula Vinculante 24 (text, via TJSP compilation)
